'''2026 Retro Worlds Jeremy Christoffel LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Christoffel]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeremy Christoffel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Christoffel LS Echo Base Operations.txt |Download]]

* '''Published list:''' 59 cards. The GEMP download also contains 59 cards.<ref name="published-list">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-jeremy-christoffel-echo-base-operations/ 2026 Retro World Championship LS Jeremy Christoffel Echo Base Operations], [[Players Committee]] (2 November 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114010152/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-jeremy-christoffel-echo-base-operations.html Internet Archive].</ref>
